tagline: 美能达取景器相机，1992 年发布
description: 美能达于1992年推出的取景器相机。配备35 mm f/4,5.。快门速度Behind-the-lens mechanical shutter, 1/35–1/100 s.。使用Automatic advance and rewind.。感光度DX coded films from ISO 100 to 400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.。Fixed focus from 1,5 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Fixed focus from 1,5 m to infinity.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, automatically activated. Range: 1,5–2,8 m. Flash ready LED indicator.
specs.感光度: DX coded films from ISO 100 to 400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Riva 35 ST, known as the Freedom Holiday in America, is a basic fixed-focus compact camera released as the successor to the Minolta Riva 35 in 1992.
